I am a current fourth-year student at the University of Pittsburgh, completing my Bachelor of Philosophy in Public Health. Along the way, I minored in applied statistics, economics, and global policy while completing a global health certificate.

<img src="simontfisher_github_headshot.JPG" style="float: right; margin-left: 20px; margin-bottom: 10px; width: 250px;"/>

I am deeply passionate about supporting innovation at the intersection of these fields, particularly through the use of biostatistics. I hope to study the safety and efficacy of infectious disease pharmaceuticals, manage global clinical trials, and improve medication access.

My background involves interdisciplinary research with both pharmacists and international teams, perspectives I look to integrate into a career leveraging pharmacoepidemiology and pharmaceutical outcomes research for global health progress.

I am always happy to connect with researchers and industry professionals — I am best reached at `stf58@pitt.edu` or `simonfisher412@gmail.com`.
